topicA: AI's Impact on Search and Content Strategy
topicB: Data Quality and Signal Loss in B2B Marketing

recap.intro: This week you explored two areas of B2B marketing that are rapidly changing: the big impact of AI on how we approach search and content, and the critical importance of data quality in all our marketing efforts.
bullets: AI is changing content creation into managing how all content works together, and human guidance remains essential.
For online sales, the real challenge with AI is ensuring your checkout process can handle super-fast, non-human shoppers.
Most AI issues stem from poor data quality, as messy information can make mistakes bigger and faster.
Even with widespread AI use, businesses are now looking for people with good judgment and quality assurance skills.
recap.closing: This week you learned that while AI is rapidly changing B2B marketing, human judgment, quality data, and strategic oversight are more crucial than ever.
